bio.text: Tim Fleming is the Republican nominee for Georgia Secretary of State in the November 2026 general election, after winning the June 16 runoff.
He represents District 114 in the Georgia House of Representatives, which covers all of Morgan County and parts of Newton and Walton counties, and was first elected to the House in 2022.
He previously served as chief of staff to Governor Brian Kemp and as deputy secretary of state under Kemp.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from the University of Georgia.
